# Experiment 7 & 8 results (generated by experiments/summarize.py)

HeatGuard v2 backend (ayushiranjan27/heatguard:2.0, 7-day forecast per request). Workload (identical for every run): 15000 POST /predict requests built from real IMD 2024 windows, 20 concurrent clients, 100 warm-up requests, fixed seed. Values are mean ± std over 3 repeats. Containers with Docker CPU/memory limits on an Apple M2 laptop (Docker Desktop VM: 8 CPUs, 3.8 GiB) emulate cloud instance sizes.

**Costs are ESTIMATES, not actual charges**: AWS Fargate on-demand Linux/ARM, ap-south-1 (Mumbai): USD 0.02383 per vCPU-hour + USD 0.00261 per GB-hour (AWS public price list, published 2026-09-11). Cost per 1M predictions = hourly cost / (throughput × 3600) × 10^6.

## Experiment 7: right-sizing

| Config | CPU peak % of 1 core | CPU used % of limit | Mem peak MiB | Mem used % of limit | Throughput req/s | p50 ms | p95 ms | Errors | Est. USD/hour | Est. USD per 1M predictions |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| over-provisioned (2.0 vCPU, 2g) | 85.7 ± 1.3 | 42.8 ± 0.7 | 113.9 ± 6.9 | 5.6 ± 0.3 | 416.8 ± 13.6 | 21.6 ± 2.1 | 162.1 ± 5.6 | 0 | 0.0529 | 0.0353 |
| right-sized (1.25 vCPU, 192m) | 99.1 ± 3.6 | 79.3 ± 2.9 | 106.5 ± 1.3 | 55.5 ± 0.7 | 436.4 ± 18.4 | 26.3 ± 3.2 | 152.1 ± 6.8 | 0 | 0.0303 | 0.0193 |


Change after right-sizing: throughput 4.7%, p50 21.8%, p95 -6.2%, hourly cost -42.7%, cost per 1M predictions -45.3%.

## Experiment 8: instance-size comparison

Target (fixed before running Exp 8): throughput ≥ 300 req/s, p95 ≤ 250 ms, errors ≤ 0, no OOM kill. Rule: At most 25% lower throughput and at most 50% higher p95 latency than the over-provisioned reference (2 vCPU / 2 GB: ~417 req/s, p95 ~162 ms), no errors, no OOM kill.

| Config | CPU peak % of 1 core | CPU used % of limit | Mem peak MiB | Mem used % of limit | Throughput req/s | p50 ms | p95 ms | Errors | Est. USD/hour | Est. USD per 1M predictions | Meets target |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| low (0.25 vCPU, 512m) | 27.1 ± 0.1 | 108.4 ± 0.4 | 119.7 ± 0.3 | 23.4 ± 0.1 | 62.9 ± 0.8 | 289.4 ± 2.5 | 869.6 ± 49.2 | 0 | 0.0073 | 0.0320 | no |
| medium (0.5 vCPU, 1g) | 50.8 ± 0.6 | 101.7 ± 1.1 | 118.3 ± 0.8 | 11.6 ± 0.1 | 302.7 ± 8.3 | 76.3 ± 1.1 | 109.2 ± 2.9 | 0 | 0.0145 | 0.0133 | yes |
| high (1.0 vCPU, 2g) | 83.1 ± 5.9 | 83.1 ± 5.9 | 114.5 ± 7.2 | 5.6 ± 0.3 | 435.7 ± 7.3 | 22.2 ± 1.4 | 153.0 ± 3.1 | 0 | 0.0290 | 0.0185 | yes |


**Most cost-efficient config meeting the target: medium** (USD 0.0133 per 1M predictions).
